# `Scanner/T1Transmit-v1` · T1 in marked regions with an uncalibrated transmit field

**A · Signal and contrast** · quantitative mapping · kind 1, measure · isolates A29: Relaxation-time mapping: T1, T2 and T2* from a series of scans, and what biases them. [The map](../../docs/tasks.md)

**Status:** PRACTICE: level(s) 1 admitted; ignores_profile loses only 9.0 points against the reference (lower bound 6.3 < 25)

A hidden QA phantom (gel body and 4 to 7 vials) on the 3 T scanner. The agent must deliver T1 per marked region within a scan-time budget. The answer is wrong unless the transmit-field error is mapped and corrected, the slice profile of a 2D scan is modelled (or a non-selective 3D acquisition is paid for) and the gradient-echo protocol keeps spoiling errors small.

Kind of task: **measurement** (a fixed protocol passes: the `open_loop` control plays one fixed scan list with a fixed estimator).

Registered as practice: every instance needs the same procedure, so the family tests whether the measurement is done right, not a decision. The gate table reports the fixed protocol (`open_loop`) next to the reference.

```python
import mrgym
env = mrgym.make("Scanner/T1Transmit-v1", level=2, seed=0)
obs, info = env.reset()
obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step({"name": "scanner_info", "arguments": {}})
```

| Given | Deliver | Scored by |
|---|---|---|
| A QA phantom with 4 to 7 vials, the scanner, a scan-time budget | T1 of every marked vial, in ms | The hidden T1 of every vial: each delivered value within a factor 1.1 of it |

## World

- On the table: QA phantom (disc of gel with vials), 3 T, body-coil receive
- Sequences that matter here: afi, spgr, ir
- Formulas the agent is given: ideal-spoiling Ernst / AFI closed forms and the slice profile of the windowed-sinc pulse (datasheet sections 1 and 5); the served signal is the EPG steady state integrated over the slice and deviates from the closed forms at short TR and weak spoilers

| Hidden (measurable only by scanning) | Told |
|---|---|
| geometry of body and vials | region centres and radii |
| PD, T1, T2, T2', diffusion coefficient per material | T1 prior range 300 to 2500 ms |
| B1+ pattern and transmit-gain error (8 to 25 %) | the pass tolerance |
| B0 pattern and centre-frequency offset | the instrument datasheet, with the excitation pulse |
| receive profile | budget and request limits |
| inversion efficiency | realised protocol, timing, limits and cost of every plan and scan |
| noise level |  |
| the 128-bit world seed |  |

## Levels

| Level | Covered by the claim | Hidden-world prior | Budget (s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | yes | mild B1 non-uniformity; the budget has room for a non-selective 3D acquisition | 260 to 320 |
| 2 | yes | strong B1 non-uniformity; the budget only fits 2D scans, whose slice profile has to be modelled | 60 to 100 |
| 3 | yes | as level 2 with a tighter budget, long T2 and slow diffusion (spoiling is hard) | 45 to 60 |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'t1_ms': {'<region id>': '<milliseconds>'}}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; deliverable valid: exactly the region ids, values in 30 to 20000 ms
- Error: `largest over the regions of |ln(T1_delivered / T1_true)|`
- Score: `none: the reward is 1 for a pass and 0 otherwise`
- Passing: all gates and, for every region, error <= ln(1.1)

## Gate: the control policies on fresh instances

Run 2026-11-25 on engine `mrgym-engine-0.2.0`, package 0.1.0.dev0: `mrgym gate Scanner/T1Transmit-v1 --n 300 --write` (split gate, seeds 0..299; recipes tuned on split tune, seeds <set 0..2>:<0..15>). A level is admitted when the lower bound of the reference is at least 90 %, the upper bound of every must-fail policy is at most 10 % and every ablation required at the level loses at least 25 points (lower bound of the paired difference). Bounds are one-sided, 95 %. Cells: passed / instances (rate; bound).

| Policy | Must | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reference` | pass | 300/300 (100.0 %; lower bound 99.0 %) | 300/300 (100.0 %; lower bound 99.0 %) | 299/300 (99.7 %; lower bound 98.4 %) | B1 map, two gradient echoes, joint fit; the slice profile is avoided (3D) where the budget allows, else modelled |
| `prior` | fail | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | no scan; the geometric mean of the told T1 range in every region |
| `fixed_recipe` | fail | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | one token scan, then one constant T1 for every region, tuned on other worlds |
| `wrong_units` | fail | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %; upper bound 1.0 %) | the reference's numbers in seconds |
| `ignores_profile` | ablation | 289/300 (96.3 %; 3.7 points below the reference, lower bound 1.9) not required here | 273/300 (91.0 %; 9.0 points below the reference, lower bound 6.3) NOT CLEARED | 230/300 (76.7 %; 23.0 points below the reference, lower bound 18.9) NOT CLEARED | 2D scans fitted with the one-angle closed forms (the v0 reference) |
| `blind_vfa` | ablation | 0/300 (0.0 %; 100.0 points below the reference, lower bound 100.0) | 0/300 (0.0 %; 100.0 points below the reference, lower bound 100.0) | 0/300 (0.0 %; 99.7 points below the reference, lower bound 99.1) | two gradient echoes at nominal flip angles, no B1 map (confounder-blind) |
| `open_loop` | reported | 299/300 (99.7 %) | 298/300 (99.3 %) | 299/300 (99.7 %) | a fixed scan list and a fixed estimator: the 2D protocol with fixed averages, the profile-aware fit |
| `profile_2d` | reported | 300/300 (100.0 %) | 300/300 (100.0 %) | 299/300 (99.7 %) | 2D scans with the slice-profile model at every level |
| `nonselective_3d` | reported | 300/300 (100.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %) | the non-selective 3D acquisition at every level; the prior answer where it does not fit the budget |
| `ir_only` | reported | 41/300 (13.7 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %) | 0/300 (0.0 %) | inversion recovery only, as much as fits |

Verdict per level: level 1 **admitted**; level 2 **practice** (ignores_profile loses only 9.0 points against the reference (lower bound 6.3 < 25)); level 3 **practice** (ignores_profile loses only 23.0 points against the reference (lower bound 18.9 < 25)).
Blind ceiling (the must-fail policy that passes most often): level 1 `fixed_recipe#0` 0.0 % (upper bound 1.0 %); level 2 `fixed_recipe#0` 0.0 % (upper bound 1.0 %); level 3 `fixed_recipe#0` 0.0 % (upper bound 1.0 %).
Reference, error of its answer (median / 95th percentile): level 1 0.0081 / 0.01787; level 2 0.01677 / 0.04384; level 3 0.02404 / 0.05987; scan time used (median): level 1 266.9 s, level 2 78.7 s, level 3 51.9 s.

## What the agent reads at reset (level 2, seed 0)

~~~text
# Measure T1 in marked regions with an uncalibrated transmit field
A test object of unknown composition lies in the field of view.
The transmit field is not calibrated: the flip angle a spin experiences at the centre of the slice is the nominal
flip angle times an unknown, position-dependent factor. A slice-selective pulse turns the spins by less away from
the slice centre (the slice profile; `scanner_info` with topic slice_profile describes it).

Deliver the longitudinal relaxation time T1 of each marked region, in milliseconds, with `submit`.
Regions (circles; centre and radius in mm from the isocentre; each lies inside one homogeneous material):
  R1: y -28.32, x 42.6, radius 11.5
  R2: y 4.25, x -1.8, radius 11.5
  R3: y 33.08, x -47.08, radius 11.5
  R4: y -40.8, x -33.38, radius 11.5
  R5: y 47.82, x 29.57, radius 11.5
T1 values lie between 300 and 2500 ms. Nothing else about the object or the system is known.

Passing: for every region the delivered T1 lies within a factor 1.1 of the true T1 (between T1 / 1.1 and 1.1 x T1).
The scanner's log must show that you measured. An answer in the wrong unit is wrong.

Limits. Scan time: 85 s (only `scan` spends it). Tool calls: 64 (every call counts once unless rejected). Rejected calls: 8 (a call refused for how it is written: unknown name, wrong type; costs nothing else), of them at most 3 refused `submit` calls. The episode ends at `submit` or at a limit; without `submit` the score is 0.
[scan time left 85.00 of 85 s · calls 0/64 · rejected 0/8]
~~~

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier reads the hidden T1 and scans nothing.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
